sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy

Every fact block in parts C and C-two of this section cites exactly one physical page of the registered snapshot by anchor, and the statement is paraphrased from that page alone; the fatality facts, the driver's duties and the first pedestrian duties resolve to the first selected page, the remaining pedestrian duties and the school bus law to the second, the motorist's bicycle guidance and the first bicyclist rules to the third, and the remaining bicycle rules and safety tips to the fourth.

Confidence: high across the section; every rule is printed directly on its page. One source-form caution: on the third page the word fewer in the aloha sentence is set in a separate text run that interleaves with the paragraph in the snapshot's text layer, so that sentence was reassembled in reading order.

Known source hazard: the manual's text layer carries a superseded hidden layer on some pages; every statement here was checked against the visible rendered page, not the hidden text, and no claim rests on hidden lines.

corpus_stability.reason: The Hawaii Driver's Manual is a periodically reprinted reference (imprint HMG 5/2023, copyright line through 2023); the Hawaii pedestrian fatality facts, the driver's and the pedestrian's legal and safety duties, stopping for a school bus, and sharing the road with bicyclists together with the rules and safety tips for riding a bicycle rules on pages 95–98 are statutory and procedural content that changes less than once a year, so no BlockedProbe.
